paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) on the x-axis and BLEU score on the y-axis for four different methods evaluated on the IWSLT14 De dataset. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” spans from 2.0 to 11.0 with tick marks at 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0, using a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 26 to 34, with major gridlines and tick labels at integer intervals. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Consistency-CE” (purple with circle markers, dashed line) starts at approximately BLEU 26.2 at AL 2.5 and rises steadily to about 31.3 at AL 10.5; “Inconsistency-CE” (dark purple with square markers, solid line) begins near BLEU 26.5 at AL 2.5 and increases to roughly 31.5 at AL 10.5; “Inconsistency-CE-MP” (blue with square markers, dash-dot line) starts at BLEU 27.0 at AL 2.5 and climbs to about 32.2 at AL 10.5; and “Consistency-Bi” (red with star markers, solid line) begins at BLEU 30.5 at AL 4.0 and continues upward to approximately 33.1 at AL 10.5. All lines show a generally increasing trend, with “Consistency-Bi” consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across its measured range.
